summary: End-to-end UI + backend validation of the XDR waves E2E-1/E2E-2/E2E-3 plus the new /api/xdr/rbac/me/effective endpoint. Backend: 17/17 targeted pytest cases pass on the live preview URL (the new endpoint returns the exact contract for admin (CROSS_TENANT_ADMIN_ROLE, cross_tenant=true, non-empty permissions) and for analyst@nivx-live.com (TENANT_SCOPED_RBAC_GRANT, tenant=nivx-live, roles=['l1_analyst'], exactly 11 permissions); it is 403 anonymous; the 5 pre-existing RBAC surfaces (permissions/roles/users/groups/session-context) still 200 for admin; the 4 control-plane surfaces (collectors, secrets, api-keys, rule-studio/rules) still 401/403 anonymously and 401/403 with the spoofed X-Tenant-Id/X-Principal-Id headers; analyst is refused on /api/xdr/api-keys). Frontend: /xdr/incidents renders incidents-table with 25 rows, incidents-state-tabs toggle URL, search filters, columns opens, sort-priority clickable, next paginates; clicking a row opens incident-flyout WITHOUT navigating away (URL stayed /xdr/incidents?state=new), flyout body shows verdict/priority/risk chips plus 'No technique mapped' honesty text, flyout-close returns to queue; bulk actions surface (incidents-bulk-assign + incidents-bulk-progress both enabled for admin — NOT clicked). /xdr/incidents/{id} renders incident-workspace with header + tabs; all 10 new tab keys (overview/story/timeline/evidence/entities/detections/mitre/response/activity/report) render their matching data-testid body. All 7 legacy tab aliases resolve on hard-refresh (attack_story→story, executive→overview, technical→detections, attack_graph→entities, recommendations→response, notes→activity, closure→activity — the closure alias was verified with a hard refresh in a second pass and rendered incident-tab-activity as designed). /xdr/assets shows assets-tenant-required for admin, assets-pick-tenant-default loads assets-devices-table (5 rows on the default tenant in this preview DB, not 19 as the request expected — data-driven, not a code bug); assets-tabs-{devices,users,cloud,applications} all work; users shows assets-users-table + assets-users-derivation; cloud shows assets-cloud-unavailable; applications shows assets-applications-unavailable. Clicking a device opens asset-flyout with asset-flyout-body; asset-flyout-entity360 navigates to /xdr/endpoints/{device_ref}. /xdr/endpoints correctly redirects to /xdr/assets. Legacy /xdr/assets/{identity,network,attack-paths,critical} all still resolve to their NOT_IMPLEMENTED pages (not shadowed by the new route). Analyst sidebar shows exactly Control Center, Incidents, Investigate, Intelligence, Assets — Data Sources/Client Management/Administration/Automate correctly hidden. Direct-navigation to /xdr/admin/api-keys as analyst renders the shell but the API returns 403 and the panel shows 'API KEYS UNAVAILABLE · ACCESS_DENIED — permission-not-granted' — matches the request statement (frontend route guard is not the security boundary; backend refusal is).

ui_bugs.issue: For the device_ref that opened from the Assets flyout on tenant 'default', the Entity 360 page did NOT render the data-testid='entity360-tab' NxTabs bar in the automated pass — the page fell into the identity-unresolved / no-events branch (xdr-trajectory-empty) so the tabs container was not rendered. Not a component bug per se (NxTabs at line 513 of XdrEntity360Page.jsx does emit `entity360-tab` / `entity360-tab-{key}` via testid prop), but on this seeded device Entity 360 has no evidence and so the tab bar is only reachable when events.length > 0. The E2E-3 requirement 'tabs entity360-tab-{...} switch' cannot be exercised for devices with no observations — recommend rendering the tab bar unconditionally so the shape is testable and users can see the empty-state per tab.

integration_issues.issue: The XdrShell still renders the full ADMINISTRATION section sub-nav (Audit Log, Secrets Store, Capability Hub, Users & Roles, API Keys, Webhooks, Platform Health, ...) in the section rail even though the top-level 'Administration' primary is correctly hidden for the analyst. Individual pages return 403 from the API and render honest ACCESS_DENIED panels, so this is a UI leakage rather than a data leakage — but it visibly contradicts the role-aware rail filter and lets an analyst enumerate the admin surface tree. Recommend routing the section-level rail through the same access.canAny() filter as the top rail.

issues: Risk column shows numeric scores for all 5 seeded devices in this preview, so the 'em dash / not scored' honesty branch could not be visually verified in this pass. The rendering path exists in code but is data-conditional.

action_items: Consider rendering the Administration section sub-nav through the same access.canAny() filter so an analyst who deep-links into an admin URL doesn't see the enumerated admin sub-tree even though every backend call is 403. The security boundary already holds; this is a UI-honesty gap.

Consider rendering the entity360-tab NxTabs container unconditionally on XdrEntity360Page even when events.length === 0 so the tab shape is testable and users on empty devices can still see and switch tabs (each showing an honest empty state).

Pre-existing (NOT caused by this session, but observed): /xdr/mss-dashboard throws React runtime error 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {code, permission, reason})' from IntelligenceControlPanel when a permission-denial object is rendered directly instead of stringified. Report only — main agent's session did not touch mss-dashboard.
Assets devices row count on tenant 'default' in this preview DB is 5, not 19 as the review request states. Verify whether the seed data drifted or whether the target tenant was different.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/xdr/rbac/me/effective is a strict projection of _resolve_user_permissions() — it never introduces a second permission algorithm, never trusts a header for tenant/principal, and never returns permissions for a tenant the caller does not belong to. Verified by testing analyst@nivx-live.com and asserting tenant='nivx-live' and permission count == 11.

AccessProvider's three-valued can()/canAny() (true/false/null) is important — the rail filter uses canAny(requires) !== false so a not-yet-loaded contract does not hide navigation. Do not regress this to a two-valued boolean.

LEGACY_TAB_ALIASES in XdrIncidentDetailPage.jsx correctly maps closure→activity, notes→activity, executive→overview, technical→detections, attack_graph→entities, recommendations→response, attack_story→story. All seven verified by hard-refresh deep-link.

Incident flyout correctly opens without navigating (URL preserved as /xdr/incidents?state=new after row click); honesty text 'No technique mapped to this incident' is rendered when MITRE data is absent — no fabricated zero.

/xdr/endpoints route correctly redirects to /xdr/assets while the legacy /xdr/assets/{identity,network,attack-paths,critical} pages still resolve to their NOT_IMPLEMENTED sinks — the new /xdr/assets did NOT shadow them, confirming the route table ordering.

rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bug. Two soft issues: (1) entity360-tab bar is only rendered when events.length>0 in XdrEntity360Page.jsx (currently around line 513, tabs live inside the events-present branch of the split view). If a device has zero persisted observations the tabs never render, so the E2E requirement 'entity360-tab switches' cannot be exercised for such devices. Fix: hoist <NxTabs testid='entity360-tab'/> above the events.length===0 check so the tab bar always exists and each tab handles its own empty state. (2) The Administration section sub-nav in XdrShell.jsx does not participate in the AccessProvider.canAny() rail filter that was added for the primary rail — when an analyst deep-links to /xdr/admin/api-keys the shell still enumerates the admin subtree even though every subpage is refused 403 by the backend and shows the honest ACCESS_DENIED panel. Fix: extend the same requires:[...] + canAny() filter down into section rails.
